title: Modern Climb
description: Adds modern Minecraft 1.14+ ladder climbing mechanics to Forge 1.8.9.
body:
# Modern Climb
Modern Climb improves ladder and vine movement in Minecraft Forge 1.8.9 by bringing the smoother climbing mechanics from newer Minecraft versions.

Features:
- Hold SPACE to climb ladders automatically
- Vanilla ladder movement preserved
- Proper ladder slide-down behavior
- SHIFT stops movement on ladders
- Supports ladders and vines
- Lightweight and client-side

Perfect for PvP, parkour, and quality-of-life improvements.
